name: imgpreview-dropzone
title: Image Preview Dropzone
description: A dashed upload box for images that lists picked files as small square thumbnails underneath. Each can be removed, and the upload is capped at four files of 1MB.
use: Users attach a few photos and should see what they picked before submitting.
avoid: Hard limit of four files and 1MB each, with no message explaining a rejection.
a11y: The upload copy is styled text rather than a form label; thumbnails do carry the file name through alt text. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide dashed-border rounded rectangle on near-black, holding a small upload cloud icon and two lines of centred text. Below it sit two square image thumbnails with rounded corners, each with a small corner remove button.
behaves: Dragging files over the zone or clicking it opens the picture picker; chosen images appear as small square previews beneath the box, each with an X to remove. Up to four files of 1MB are accepted.
customise: Nothing is exposed: the accepted formats, the four-file and 1MB limits and the copy are fixed in the file.
weight: light: A drop zone and a few thumbnails; no loops or heavy libraries.
demo: Two blue and orange gradient sample images
issues: No error message appears when a file is rejected for size or type.
polishWhy: Clean, legible drop zone; plain thumbnails and no rejection feedback keep it ordinary.
